tasks.title: Install, Update & First Launch
tasks.purpose: Validate Play/release installation, update, clean installation, first launch, permission behavior, backup boundaries, and application identity.
tasks.deviceRequirements: Assigned release/Play build; eligible earlier Alpha where required; clean-install capability.

mutation.label: No live mutation authorization is needed.

tasks.safetyWarning: Record the assigned installation path; do not substitute an unapproved build.

tasks.title: Navigation & Station Playback
tasks.purpose: Exercise navigation, startup station behavior, exit, foreground playback, station switching, metadata, station cards, mini-player behavior, and one-player ownership.
tasks.stationScope: Coordinator may assign one station; distribute PT-03 across all five stations.

mutation.label: No live mutation authorization is needed.

tasks.safetyWarning: PT-03 is cohort-distributed; one tester is not expected to cover every station.

tasks.title: Background Media & Sleep Timer
tasks.purpose: Exercise background playback, MediaSession/system controls, lifecycle transitions, audio focus, task removal, and Sleep Timer creation, adjustment, cancellation, expiry, and recovery.
tasks.deviceRequirements: Android device with system media controls.

mutation.label: No live mutation authorization is needed.

tasks.safetyWarning: Use only the Player and Android system controls; do not introduce external controller tools.

tasks.title: Audio Output Routing
tasks.purpose: Test Android-owned media routing, available Bluetooth/wired/USB/other hardware, route switching, disconnect fallback, and truthful route presentation.
tasks.deviceRequirements: Available Bluetooth, wired, USB, or other output hardware where assigned.
prerequisites: Assigned accessory or route when available

mutation.label: No live mutation authorization is needed.

tasks.safetyWarning: An unavailable accessory type is Blocked, not a failure.

tasks.title: Queue, History & Station Data
tasks.purpose: Validate Queue, recently played, station metadata, stale/failure behavior, requester/message visibility, artwork, and cross-station isolation.
tasks.stationScope: Assign repeatedly by station for representative all-five-station evidence.

mutation.label: No live mutation authorization is needed.

tasks.safetyWarning: Treat stale or unavailable station data truthfully; do not infer a mutation.

tasks.title: Network Loss & Recovery
tasks.purpose: Exercise full connectivity loss, bounded recovery, cancelled intent, Wi-Fi/mobile handoff, stale Queue behavior, offline reads, fail-closed request behavior, and deliberate recovery.

mutation.label: No live mutation authorization is needed.

tasks.safetyWarning: Do not use network inspection tools that expose private endpoints or session data.

tasks.title: Account Sessions & Favorites
tasks.purpose: Validate station-specific sign-in/restoration/logout isolation and Favorites loading, filtering, sorting, traversal, request availability, station switching, and account-data clearing.
tasks.stationScope: Assign by station/account; SST assignments include the approximately 1,500-item Favorites coverage.

mutation.label: No live request authorization is included.

tasks.safetyWarning: Use only an approved account; Favorites availability must remain fail-closed.

tasks.title: Request Library & Pre-Submit Safety
tasks.purpose: Exercise request-library browsing, search, navigation, suggestions, confirmation/cancel, identity, freshness, restrictions, and fail-closed states without a live request.
tasks.accountRequirements: Station/account state as assigned; no request authorization.

mutation.label: Read-only request testing only.

tasks.safetyWarning: Cancel confirmation; do not submit a live request.

tasks.title: One-Shot Song Request
tasks.purpose: Perform exactly one authorized live song-request transaction and validate identity, eligibility, Queue evidence, optional SST message, outcomes, duplicate suppression, and cooldown.
tasks.accountRequirements: Approved station account and coordinator authorization required.

mutation.label: Explicit one-request authorization required.

tasks.safetyWarning: ONE LIVE REQUEST MAXIMUM. NEVER RETRY AN INDETERMINATE RESULT. CHECK QUEUE FIRST.

tasks.title: SST Request Activity & Membership
tasks.purpose: Validate SST Request Activity, membership state, readiness/cooldown, recent summaries, session clearing, and cross-station isolation.

mutation.label: Read-only task.

tasks.safetyWarning: Do not infer membership from generic wording.

tasks.title: Community Gates & Chat
tasks.purpose: Validate age/Terms/reveal gates, legal disclosures, Chat loading, isolation, stale behavior, composer limits, and approved posting.
tasks.accountRequirements: Approved Chat account only when the optional post is authorized.

mutation.label: Default is read-only Chat validation; one harmless post requires explicit authorization.

tasks.safetyWarning: A Chat post is not implied. Use read-only validation unless the coordinator explicitly authorizes one harmless post.

tasks.title: Report, Block & Unblock
tasks.purpose: Exercise report preparation, content/user distinction, transient state, email handoff, block/unblock, station isolation, and delivery claims.

mutation.label: Inspect or cancel the email handoff; delivery is separately authorized.

tasks.safetyWarning: Do not send a moderation email merely because this task is assigned. Delivery must be specifically authorized.

tasks.title: Chat Mention Notifications
tasks.purpose: Validate mention opt-in, permission outcomes, display-name matching, suppression, minimal notification payload, and navigation.

mutation.label: Controlled posting authorization required.

tasks.safetyWarning: Do not improvise the two-account setup or post outside the approved controlled scenario.

tasks.title: Contact & Privacy-Safe Diagnostics
tasks.purpose: Validate Contact Us handoff, external-route restrictions, return-to-app state, protected-session separation, and privacy-safe diagnostics/copy/share behavior.
tasks.stationScope: Record assigned station scope for PT-18 where applicable.

mutation.label: No Contact Us email needs to be sent.

tasks.safetyWarning: Inspect or cancel email/share handoff; do not send private diagnostics.

tasks.title: Adaptive UI & Lifecycle
tasks.purpose: Exercise layouts, form factors, multi-window, rotation/resizing, themes, input, edge-to-edge, Back, multi-resume, and lifecycle continuity.
tasks.deviceRequirements: Assigned phone, tablet, foldable, multi-window, or input configuration.

mutation.label: No live mutation authorization is needed.

tasks.safetyWarning: Record the actual device, posture, window, and input configuration.

tasks.title: Accessibility & TalkBack
tasks.purpose: Validate enlarged text/display scale, TalkBack traversal, semantics, focus, non-color state, controls, long content, alternative input, and posture transitions.
tasks.deviceRequirements: Human accessibility tester; physical-device testing preferred.

mutation.label: No live mutation authorization is needed.

tasks.safetyWarning: Record observed spoken and focus behavior; do not substitute automated accessibility claims for human testing.

tasks.title: Closed-App Notification Delivery
tasks.purpose: Future closed/background notification certification.

mutation.label: Not assignable until the delivery build is authorized.

tasks.safetyWarning: Future / Blocked — do not assign or simulate delivery.

tasks.title: Play Policy & Declarations
tasks.purpose: Validate membership/payment/account-route compliance and reconcile the exact candidate with Play declarations, privacy, Data Safety, reviewer access, audience/UGC classification, foreground media behavior, and operator facts.

mutation.label: Play coordinator only; do not assign as an ordinary volunteer task.

tasks.safetyWarning: Policy and release evidence must match the exact candidate; do not infer declarations.

tasks.title: Protected-Session Expiry & Recovery
tasks.purpose: Validate isolated expiry/rotation, cross-feature convergence, unaffected station continuity, reauthentication, recreation, and station-only cleanup.

mutation.label: Supplied harness and explicit coordinator authorization required.

tasks.safetyWarning: Do not attempt to force expiry or inspect session values without the supplied controlled harness.

tasks.title: External Controller & Station-Network Trust
tasks.purpose: Validate foreign MediaSession controller authority, Sleep Timer restrictions, stream-injection prevention, redirect/network trust, fail-closed behavior, and approved same-origin operation.

mutation.label: Supplied harness and explicit coordinator authorization required.

tasks.safetyWarning: Do not improvise controller, redirect, or stream-injection tests.

tasks.title: Private Message Program
tasks.purpose: Future Private Message reading, compose/reply/send, lifecycle, station isolation, adaptive/accessibility behavior, and notification certification.

mutation.label: Not currently assignable.

tasks.safetyWarning: Future / Blocked — Private Message program has not been authorized.

tasks.title: Cast, Extended Capabilities & Account Routes
tasks.purpose: Future Google Cast certification, independently certified station capabilities, and verified registration/recovery/management/deletion routes.

mutation.label: Not currently assignable.

tasks.safetyWarning: Future / Blocked — do not test unverified capabilities or account routes.

tasks.title: Membership Commerce Lifecycle
tasks.purpose: Future VIP/RIP purchase authorization, verification, activation, lifecycle, restore/revocation, isolation, accessibility/device certification, and policy reconciliation.

mutation.label: Not currently assignable.

tasks.safetyWarning: Future / Blocked — do not purchase, subscribe, or test commerce outside the authorized sandbox.
